name: kxust10am
title: 10Y US Treasury yield on Oct 30, 2026?
settlement: If the par yield for the 10Y U.S. Treasury is above 5.63% on Oct 30, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes. The market expires at the sooner of the first 7:00 PM ET following the data release for Oct 30, 2026, or one week following Oct 30, 2026.
decideContext: Analysts are estimating the effect of news on the closing par yield of the 10-year U.S. Treasury note on Oct 30, 2026, which determines whether the market settles Yes (above 5.63%) or No. Focus on how any given news item would push the 10Y yield up or down in basis points relative to current levels.
